name: rosetta-chinese-remainder-theorem
code:
use default

extended_gcd(a: long, b: long) -> (g: long, x: long, y: long) is
    if b == 0L then
        (g = a, x = 1L, y = 0L)
    else
        let (g, x1, y1) = extended_gcd(b, a % b)

        (g = g, x = y1, y = x1 - (a / b) * y1)
    fi
si

crt(ns: LIST[long], as: LIST[long]) -> long? is
    let big_n mut = 1L

    for n in ns do
        big_n = big_n * n
    od

    let sum mut = 0L

    for i in 0..ns.count do
        let ni = ns[i]
        let mi = big_n / ni
        let (g, s, _) = extended_gcd(mi, ni)

        if g != 1L then
            return null
        fi

        sum = sum + as[i] * mi * s
    od

    let result = sum % big_n

    if result < 0L then result + big_n else result fi
si

demo(ns: LIST[long], as: LIST[long]) is
    let result = crt(ns, as)
    let n_text = ns |> map(n => "{n}") |> join(", ")
    let a_text = as |> map(a => "{a}") |> join(", ")

    write_line("n = [{n_text}], a = [{a_text}]")

    if let x = result then
        write_line("  x = {x}")
    else
        write_line("  no solution")
    fi
si

demo(LIST[long]([3L, 5L, 7L]), LIST[long]([2L, 3L, 2L]))
demo(LIST[long]([10L, 4L, 12L]), LIST[long]([2L, 2L, 2L]))
